subject: History

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of African history before colonialism

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept of History and sources of historical information

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of theories of the origin of human beings
competences: (a) Describe the theories of the origin of human beings
(b) Describe the stages of human evolution and their technological Ages

objectives.text: (a) Describe the theories of the origin of human beings
objectives.teaching_methods: Invite religious leaders and historian/ archaeologist to present on the origin of human beings
objectives.resources: On-line sources, and journal articles on theories of the origin of human beings
objectives.assessment_criteria: Theories of the origin of human beings are correctly described

objectives.text: (b) Describe the stages of human evolution and their technological Ages

objectives.resources: Charts, pictures, journal articles on the stages of human evolution and their technological Ages
objectives.assessment_criteria: The stages of human evolution and their technological ages are clearly described

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the economic, political, social and technological development of pre-colonial Africa
competences: (a) Describe different modes of production in pre-colonial Africa
(b) Explain different economic activities and their impact on pre-colonial African societies
(c) Describe social-political organisations and education in pre-colonial African societies
